summary: All cited claims were checked against opened sources. Two issues were corrected before this verdict: the summary death date was re-cited from CBS (which does not state the date) to the obituary and Fox coroner report, and 'created the Valley View Rodeo' was changed to 'part of his legacy' to match the source wording. Local Brazilian Portuguese version checked.
